summary: The reported Frozen-KV MTP failure is specific to CUDA/SM100, TRT-LLM MHA, ModelOpt FP4, and Gemma-4 weights. The assigned accelerator is an AMD MI350X (gfx950), so neither the corrupt-output reproduction nor the depth-4 CUDA-graph illegal access can be executed faithfully. The current source was inspected and the only issue-linked candidate, upstream PR #32691, was rejected as unjustified: its proposed removal of batch_size * draft_token_num^2 contradicts the current pre-extension meaning of paged_kernel_lens_sum. No source correction was made without issue-specific execution evidence.

tests.what_was_measured: CPU-side independent boundary coverage for verify-mask element counts across batch sizes and draft widths in the prepared implementation. This does not execute Frozen-KV MTP or TRT-LLM MHA.
Hardware inventory identified the sole assigned accelerator as AMD Instinct MI350X, GFX version gfx950, rather than NVIDIA B200/SM100.

remaining_limitations: The nvidia/Gemma-4-31B-IT-NVFP4 target weights and google/gemma-4-31B-it-assistant draft weights were unavailable.
The assigned AMD gfx950 cannot reproduce an NVIDIA SM100 CUDA graph or trtllm_mha failure.
Hardware evidence is retained in reports/j-f551878179e6/hardware.txt; no issue-relevant GPU execution was performed.
No full-model, semantic-accuracy, concurrency-corruption, or depth-4 graph-capture claim was made.

Upstream PR #32691 remains open and was not adopted because its mask-size derivation conflicts with the inspected implementation; it also does not address the eager-mode corruption reported in the issue.
